grh_efc3545234d1769d8e94.title: Words at War 43-07-10 (03) They Call It Pacific
paragraphs: A dramatized selection from correspondent Clark Lee's They Call It Pacific traces the collapse of early Allied confidence as Japan sweeps through the Pacific. Lee moves from Shanghai to Manila, watches the destruction following Pearl Harbor, reports from the Philippines and Bataan, and records the belief that American reinforcements will arrive even as the military position deteriorates. He eventually escapes toward Australia while friends and fellow correspondents are killed. The program ends with Lee imagining the eventual return to the Philippines, China and Tokyo, framing his experiences as lessons learned at enormous cost.
